thread:
Mira (design): Quick feedback session: thinking about compacting the trace drilldown header and surfacing the correlation ID more clearly. mock here: https://figma.com/file/xyz
Sana (eng-ux): Nice. Proposal: show a monospace correlation pill to the right of service name. Tap/click copies ID. In compact mode collapse the pill into a single icon that opens a popover.
Ben (eng-runtime): Copy action should use the short-link redirect so users can share without exposing internal ids. Backend: /r/<short> -> full trace.
Olivia (accessibility): Pill needs aria-label: "Copy correlation ID for request 1991112345" and focus visible outline. Icon-only variant needs 4.5:1 contrast.
Raj (product): Microcopy: 'Copy trace link' vs 'Copy correlation ID' — which is less confusing?
Mira (design): 'Copy trace link' I think. People expect a shareable link. We'll keep a secondary tooltip showing the raw ID.
Arjun (support): If possible show a small toast after copy with a 'Report issue' quick-link so support can create tickets with context.
Sana (eng-ux): Good idea. Popover layout: row1 ID + copy, row2 actions: 'Open', 'Export JSON', 'Report'. Keyboard nav: Tab cycles through actions; Esc closes.
Ben (eng-runtime): Export JSON should include correlation_ids, sampled_span_count, and a short stack_summary. Large exports will be background jobs. UI should indicate pending job with aria-live updates.
Olivia (accessibility): Ensure focus trap when popover opens and return focus to trigger on close. Also announce export completion: "Export ready: trace_1991112345.json"
Mira (design): Action items: Sana update mock with icon-only compact, Olivia to add a11y checklist, Ben to confirm short-link endpoint. copybot: remind about design checklist on PR.
copybot: Design checklist: include contrast screenshots and keyboard nav gif.
Mira (design): Thanks all 44d will update after mocks are in.
